steps.name: discover-shizuku-launcher-and-runtime
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
echo '--- shizuku package path ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell pm path moe.shizuku.privileged.api
echo '--- shizuku launcher ---'
LAUNCHER="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER moe.shizuku.privileged.api 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | tail -1)"
echo "shizuku_launcher=$LAUNCHER"
if [ -n "$LAUNCHER" ] && [ "$LAUNCHER" != 'No activity found' ]; then
  adb -s "$SEL" shell am start -W -n "$LAUNCHER" >/dev/null || true
  sleep 2
fi
echo '--- Shizuku external files ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell 'find /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort -u' || true
echo '--- start.sh search ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell 'find /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 -path "*moe.shizuku.privileged.api*" -name "start.sh" -type f 2>/dev/null | sort -u' || true
echo '--- pinned phone LLM ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell 'ls -la /data/local/tmp/aicall-phone-llm 2>&1 || true'
